title: Linear Control Systems
objectives:
The main scope of this course is to teach the students linear control systems in order to be familiar with to
analyze and design single-variable linear control systems in time and frequency domain.
syllabus:
Feedback applications, modeling feedback systems, stability of zero transfer function, poles
of transfer function and its representation in coordinate systems, stability criterion for system
efficiency, system types, P, PI and PID controllers, The Routh-Hurwitz, Stability Criterion,
The Root Locus Method, Frequency Response Methods, The Nyquist Criterion and its polar
diagrams, Approximation method for high-order linear systems, M-shaped curves, Control
system design, Analog modeling and Discrete systems
textbooks:
1. Uday A. Bakshi, "Linear Control Systems", 2007.
2. Richard C. Dorf, Robert H. Bishop, "Modern Control Systems", 2010.
3. K. Ogata, Modern Centeral Engineering, 5th ed. Prentice – Hall, 2009.
